Materials in Context

This module introduces core materials and approaches to illustration and animation through building observation skills, Hanoi-based location visits, text interpretation and research.

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Apply research insights in the development of visual outcomes.

+  Demonstrate the use of a diverse range of materials, methods and processes in practice production

+  Produce a body of work together with critical, reflective documentation of material exploration.
